source.english_context: Unit 18 Dry Cleaning, Alterations, and Pickup Goal: drop off clothes, ask for cleaning or small repairs, and pick up the right order. Daily Life English I need this suit dry cleaned. Can you remove this stain? Can you hem these pants? I am here to pick up my order. How much will the cleaning cost? When will my clothes be ready? Can you clean this coat by Thursday? The care label says dry clean only. There is a coffee stain on the front. Can you replace the missing button? I would like the sleeves a little shorter. Do I need to try this on? Can you send me a pickup reminder? Is there an extra charge for faster service? May I check the clothes before I leave? Vocabulary dry cleaning special cleaning for delicate clothes stain a dirty mark on clothing alteration a change to make clothes fit better hem make pants, a skirt, or a dress shorter pickup ticket paper or text used to get your order ready date the date when your order is finished care label a tag with instructions for cleaning clothing sleeve the part of a shirt or jacket that covers an arm lining a layer of material inside clothing press use heat to make clothing smooth rush service faster service, often for an extra charge seam a line where two pieces of fabric are joined US Customs Bring the pickup ticket or show the text message when you return. Point to the exact stain, missing button, or place that needs alteration. Ask the price and ready date before leaving your clothes. Dialogue Student: I need this jacket dry cleaned, please. Clerk: Any stains or repairs? Student: Yes, there is a stain on the sleeve. Clerk: We can try to remove it. It will be ready Friday. Student: Great. I will bring this ticket for pickup.

japanese_explanation.heading: 服を預ける前に値段と日付を確認
points: ドライクリーニングでは、汚れ、取れたボタン、直してほしい場所を指で示すと伝わりやすいです。
pickup ticket は受け取りに必要です。紙、メール、SMSのどれでも、なくさないようにしましょう。
しみ抜きや直しは必ず成功するとは限りません。料金、仕上がり日、できることを先に確認します。
japanese_explanation.practice: I am here to pick up my order.

existing_simplified_chinese.heading: 把衣服留下前先确认价格和日期
points: 去干洗店时，用手指出污渍、掉扣子或需要修改的地方，会更容易说明。
pickup ticket 是取衣服时的重要凭证。纸条、邮件或短信都要保存好。
去污或修改不一定百分之百成功。离开前先确认费用、完成日期和可以做到什么。
existing_simplified_chinese.practice: I am here to pick up my order.

ko.heading: 옷을 맡기기 전에 가격과 날짜를 확인하세요.
points: 드라이클리닝 시에는 얼룩, 떨어진 단추, 수선이 필요한 부분을 손가락으로 가리켜 설명하면 더 이해하기 쉽습니다.
'pickup ticket'은 옷을 찾을 때 필요합니다. 종이 영수증이든, 이메일이나 SMS 메시지든 잃어버리지 않도록 주의하세요.
얼룩 제거 또는 수선이 항상 성공하는 것은 아닙니다. 옷을 맡기기 전에 요금, 완성 예정일, 그리고 가능한 작업에 대해 먼저 확인하세요.

es.heading: Confirme el precio y la fecha antes de dejar la ropa.
points: Al llevar ropa a la tintorería, es más fácil comunicarse si señala las manchas, los botones perdidos o los lugares que necesitan una alteración.
El 'pickup ticket' es necesario para recoger su pedido. Asegúrese de no perderlo, ya sea en papel, correo electrónico o SMS.
La eliminación de manchas o las alteraciones no siempre tienen éxito. Confirme el costo, la fecha de finalización y lo que se puede hacer de antemano.

pt-BR.heading: Confirme o preço e a data antes de deixar a roupa.
points: Ao deixar roupas para lavagem a seco, é mais fácil se comunicar apontando a mancha, o botão que falta ou o local que precisa de alteração.
O 'pickup ticket' é necessário para retirar seu pedido. Seja em papel, e-mail ou SMS, certifique-se de não perdê-lo.
A remoção de manchas ou alterações nem sempre são garantidas. Confirme o custo, a data de entrega e o que pode ser feito antecipadamente.

fr.heading: Confirmez le prix et la date avant de laisser vos vêtements.
points: Pour le nettoyage à sec, il est plus facile de communiquer en pointant du doigt les taches, les boutons manquants ou les zones nécessitant une retouche.
Le « pickup ticket » est nécessaire pour récupérer votre commande. Qu'il s'agisse d'un reçu papier, d'un e-mail ou d'un SMS, veillez à ne pas le perdre.
La suppression des taches ou les retouches ne sont pas toujours garanties. Confirmez le coût, la date de disponibilité et ce qui peut être fait à l'avance.

de.heading: Bestätigen Sie Preis und Datum, bevor Sie Kleidung abgeben.
points: Bei der Reinigung ist es einfacher, sich zu verständigen, wenn Sie mit dem Finger auf Flecken, fehlende Knöpfe oder Stellen zeigen, die geändert werden müssen.
Der „pickup ticket“ wird zur Abholung Ihrer Bestellung benötigt. Egal, ob es sich um einen Papierbeleg, eine E-Mail oder eine SMS handelt, stellen Sie sicher, dass Sie ihn nicht verlieren.
Fleckenentfernung oder Änderungen sind nicht immer garantiert erfolgreich. Klären Sie Kosten, Fertigstellungsdatum und Machbarkeit im Voraus ab.
